title: openai-compat: tool_choice semantics, schema mapping, and tool message formatting
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: upstream OpenAI models now emit richer tool selection signals (tool_choice payloads with optional schema hints and message-formatting metadata). We previously accepted only simple tool calls and arguments blobs which caused two issues: 1) ambiguity when a tool returns multiple message variants, and 2) incorrect mapping of OpenAI schema types to Redwood's internal handler schemas. This PR updates the OpenAI compatibility layer to support tool schema mapping, formalizes tool_choice semantics, and normalizes tool message formatting so Redwood can route, validate, and render tool invocations deterministically. Changes include: 1) schema mapping: we add a pluggable mapper that converts OpenAI tool parameter schemas (JSON Schema-ish) into Redwood's canonical argument-schema representation, with type coercions and nullable handling; 2) tool_choice semantics: tool_choice is now interpreted as a ranked selection structure and we accept both the legacy "tool_call" shorthand and the full object form {"name":..., "index":..., "reason":...}. The compatibility layer applies a best-effort reconciliation strategy when the model provides partial schema hints; 3) message formatting: tool messages are normalized to a two-part structure {"user_facing":..., "machine_facing":...} driven by the tool's declared message_format ("plain", "structured", or "tool-fragment"). Migration notes: existing integrations that relied on raw model tool_call payloads will continue to work via the legacy adapter, but teams are encouraged to update handlers to consume the normalized message_format fields. API/example: POST /v1/compat/chat with model response containing tool_choice: {"name":"calculator","index":0,"schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"x":{"type":"number"},"y":{"type":"number"}}},"message_format":"structured"} will be converted to an internal invocation: {"handler":"calculator","args_schema_id":"calc_schema_v2","args":{"x":1.2,"y":3}} where calc_schema_v2 is synthesized by the mapper and stored in the request context for validation. Testing: added unit tests for schema mapping, integration tests for end-to-end tool invocation with mock handlers, and a canary test to assert backward compatibility with legacy tool_call flows. Backwards compatibility and safety: the mapper enforces strict validation only when the tool is registered with a schema; otherwise we fall back to permissive parsing and a logged warning. Rollout: feature gated behind OPENAI_COMPAT_TOOLCHOICE flag and enabled by default for canary customers. Checklist: - [x] add schema mapper and tests - [x] implement tool_choice reconciliation - [x] normalize tool message formatting - [x] update docs and examples - [x] add e2e integration tests - [x] feature flag + rollout plan
commits_summary: 4 commits: initial mapper and tests; integrate mapper into compat layer; normalize message formatting and update handlers; docs and changelog updates
